We evaluate multilingual text generation performance using two benchmarks. First, FLORES-101  is used to evaluate the model's general generation quality across a broad set of high-and low-resource languages. Second, FLORES-200 (Costa-Jussà et al., 2022) is employed to test zero-shot cross-lingual transfer capabilities-specifically, the model's ability to generate high-quality outputs in languages it was not directly trained on.
outputs: Translated sentences, instruction-following responses, paraphrased texts

The models generate translated text in multiple languages, particularly in machine translation tasks evaluated on FLORES-101 and FLORES-200, assessing both high- and low-resource language performance in zero-shot settings.
